items.new_text: Given a proposal in the proposals window, when the operator rejects it, then one block with the proposed line as the lead wrote it, the lead, the rejection time and the reason (when one was given) is added to the organization's shared list of rejected decisions, the list is created with a short heading when it does not exist yet, and a retry after an interruption never adds the same block twice.

Given a rejection reason or a countersign note that is longer than 600 characters or repeats a quote of the lead, when the operator submits the decision, then it is refused with a plain explanation and nothing is changed.

Given a proposal the operator countersigns with a note, when it is logged, then the decisions log holds the note as its own item below the logged line, and a countersign without a note logs exactly what it logged before.
